title: ECCS V3
features:
This is a completely new tool to simplify the game. It still works faster than Arceus X, Delta, Fluxus and etc. The design was rewritten from scratch and made as comfortable as possible physically and for perception. Many features have been added, as well as new sections such as music and home where there is more important information about the game and the player than in the old versions. You will be able to test all this and a lot of new things after executing the script.

!!!WARNING!!!
Be careful when scrolling the script feed. The secure script execution system has been removed, which is why some scripts can harm your account. This was done due to some mistakes. Use scripts from verifided authors and authors what you trust.
